Create an endpoint; its secret is printed once

Usage:
  kaab webhooks create --url URL --events job.*,credits.low [flags]

Flags:
      --description string   a note
      --events strings       event types or patterns: job.*, credits.low, * (comma-separated)
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --mode string          live, test or both (both by default)
      --url string           the https endpoint

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
